Interface ResourceItem

public interface ResourceItem
Implemented by a CraftEngine item behavior whose item holds one resource: the engine's machineengine:energy_item and machineengine:resource_item, or an addon's own (D32). The amount lives in the item's data (ItemResources); the behavior only says what the item holds and how much.

An item may hold several resources (energy and hydrogen): one behavior per resource.
